ns2:course.label: Sem 20thC Spanish Lit
ns2:course.description: Investigation of literary problems presented by the Spanish novel, drama, poetry and/or essay since 1900. May be repeated to a maximum of 8 hours if topics vary. Prerequisite: SPAN 465 or equivalent.
